# netactuate_http_loadbalancer_group (Resource)

Manages a HTTP Loadbalancer Group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_http_loadbalancer_group" "example" {
  algorithm = "round_robin"
  backend {
    internal_address = "192.0.2.10"
    name             = "example"
  }
  http_loadbalancer_id = 12345
  internal_port        = 80
  match_address        = "192.0.2.10"
  match_ports          = "80"
  name                 = "example"
  rule {
    match_domain = "example.com"
    match_path   = "/"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `algorithm` (String) Load balancing algorithm (round-robin or least-connections)
- `backend` (Block List, Min: 1) Backend servers (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--backend))
- `http_loadbalancer_id` (Number) The ID of the HTTP load balancer
- `internal_port` (Number) The port to connect to on the backends
- `match_address` (String) Public IP address to match incoming traffic
- `match_ports` (String) Ports to match (80, 443, or 80+443)
- `name` (String) Name of the HTTP LB group
- `rule` (Block List, Min: 1) Domain/path routing rules (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the HTTP LB group
- `health_check_active_delay` (Number) Active health check delay in seconds
- `health_check_active_enabled` (Boolean) Whether active health checks are enabled
- `health_check_active_interval` (Number) Active health check interval in seconds
- `health_check_active_path` (String) Active health check HTTP path
- `health_check_active_retries` (Number) Active health check retries
- `health_check_active_timeout` (Number) Active health check timeout in seconds
- `health_check_passive_enabled` (Boolean) Whether passive health checks are enabled
- `ssl_to_backend_enabled` (Boolean) Whether to use SSL when connecting to backends
- `sticky_sessions_enabled` (Boolean) Whether to enable sticky sessions

### Read-Only

- `http_group_id` (Number) The group ID
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_online` (Boolean) Whether the group is online

<a id="nestedblock--backend"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backend`

Required:

- `internal_address` (String) Internal IP address of the backend
- `name` (String) Name of the backend

Read-Only:

- `http_backend_id` (Number) The backend ID assigned by the API
- `is_online` (Boolean) Whether this backend is online


<a id="nestedblock--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Required:

- `match_domain` (String) Domain to match
- `match_path` (String) Path to match

Optional:

- `https_redirect_enabled` (Boolean) Whether to redirect HTTP to HTTPS
- `ssl_certificate_id` (Number) SSL certificate ID (omit for auto SSL)
- `ssl_enabled` (Boolean) Whether SSL is enabled for this rule

Read-Only:

- `http_rule_id` (Number) The rule ID assigned by the API

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_http_loadbalancer_group.example 12345
```
